transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Korean retail investors faced major losses as AI semiconductor stocks plunged over 20 percent, reported by 파이낸셜뉴스, with Nvidia investors losing 2 trillion won in two weeks.
Anthropic reported strong Q3 2026 growth and secured 15 billion dollars in credit for an IPO in November, still open per Forkast News regarding their 16.8 billion dollar quarterly performance.
A Lebanese family is suing OpenAI over their son's suicide, reported by Al Bawaba News.
Claude cracked a 25 year NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes by tracing NSA linked crypto numbers to 1990s software and debunking backdoor theory, confirmed by ynetnews.
WeChat permanently banned an account accused of artificial intelligence impersonation by actress Wu Yue, reported by 新浪财经, amid rising artificial intelligence deepfake concerns.
